---
title: Green Agliata Monferrina
id: MAR-0014
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 6
time_min: 55
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g robiola or crescenza
- 100 g ricotta
- 25 g fresh parsley
- 10 small celery leaves
- 5 basil leaves
- 10 mint leaves
- 2 tablespoons lemon juice
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Wash and dry the parsley, celery, mint, and basil leaves.
2. Place them in a mortar with the peeled garlic, a pinch of salt, and a grind of pepper, and pound.
3. Then add the lemon and oil, then mix.
4. Combine the robiola with the ricotta and pour the mixture over it, blending all ingredients to obtain a cream.
5. Keep in the refrigerator until serving.
